definitions.gloss: in all sincerity, with one's whole heart
definitions.explanation: Acting with complete sincerity and dedication; putting one's whole heart into something.

examples.japanese: {誠心誠意|せいしんせいい}お{詫|わ}び{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます。
examples.english: I sincerely apologize from the bottom of my heart.

examples.japanese: {誠心誠意|せいしんせいい}{尽|つ}くしますので、よろしくお{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: I will do my utmost with complete sincerity, so please count on me.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{誠心誠意|せいしんせいい}{対応|たいおう}してくれた。
examples.english: He dealt with the matter with complete sincerity.

notes:
FOUR-CHARACTER IDIOM ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}):
{誠心|せいしん} (sincere heart) + {誠意|せいい} (sincerity)

COMPONENTS:
- {誠|せい}: sincerity, truth
- {心|しん}: heart, mind
- {意|い}: intention, meaning

LITERAL MEANING:
"With sincere heart and sincere intention" - doubling the concept of sincerity for emphasis.

USAGE PATTERNS:
・{誠心誠意|せいしんせいい}お{詫|わ}びする (to apologize most sincerely)
・{誠心誠意|せいしんせいい}{尽|つ}くす (to devote oneself wholeheartedly)
・{誠心誠意|せいしんせいい}{対応|たいおう}する (to respond with complete sincerity)

REGISTER:
Formal. Often used in business contexts, apologies, or when emphasizing genuine commitment. Very common in customer service language.
